snippet.title: Phoenix: Fire and Life Incarnate | Character Reveal | Marvel Rivals
snippet.description:
Description: Omega-level telepath and original X-Men, Jean Grey soars to cosmic heights when bonded with the Phoenix Force — the embodiment of creation itself. Now, she travels the stars as both savior and destroyer, confronting the darkness at its source: Knull, the King in Black.  

On July 11 UTC, rise from the ashes and unleash your power as Phoenix In Marvel Rivals! 🐦‍🔥  

Play free now on:   
🔹 Steam: https://t.co/IPhy0Of1cG 
🔹 PlayStation: https://t.co/FR0aVfTmcn 
🔹 Xbox: https://t.co/GaAYz7Nku6 
🔹 Epic Games: https://t.co/QXoxz0VAP7
